  Recommendation as submitted by Supervisor Barger: Approve the

  Homekey+Program …

  AMEND:

  Also, consideration of Supervisor Solis’ recommendation to
  amend Supervisor Barger’s motion to approve the projects with
  the five six properties to be submitted to the Homekey+Program
  located at 201 South Alvarado Street in the City of Los Angeles,
 3525 Torrance Boulevard in the City of Torrance, 4752 South Main
Street in the City of Los Angeles, 1657-61 North Western Avenue
in the City of Los Angeles, 343 First Street in the City of Los
Angeles, and 5350 South Huntington Drive in the City of Los
Angeles; adopt resolutions authorizing and directing the
Executive Director of the Los Angeles County Development
Authority to submit joint applications, on behalf of the County, to
the California Department of Housing and Community
Development in response to the Notice of Funding Availability,
and to jointly apply for Homekey+ grant funds in the amounts
indicated in each authorizing resolution; approve funding to the
National Community Renaissance of California for the Huntington
Villas project, located at 5350 South Huntington Drive in the City
of Los Angeles, using up to a total of $5,200,000 in Mental Health
Services Act and/or Behavioral Health Services Act funds, and
authorize transfer of such funds to the Los Angeles County
Development Authority (LACDA) for the project; authorize the
Directors of Mental Health, Public Health, through its Substance
Abuse Prevention and Control Bureau, Health Services, and/or
Military and Veterans Affairs, to allocate up to $3,300,000 in any
unused rental or capital subsidy, approve funding to LTSC
Community Development Corporation or County approved
designee for the Daimaru Hotel project, and authorize transfer of
such funds to LACDA for the project and, if necessary, authorize
the Director of Mental Health to execute a funding agreement with
LACDA for the transfer of such funds; and find that the five six
projects are exempt from the California Environmental Quality
Act. (Relates to Agenda No. 1-D) (25-2349)

9.. Remote Public Comment

The Board of Supervisors is debuting a new way to provide public comment during Board meetings. For detailed instructions about using the new system, how to find Board agendas, or more general information, please visit the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors’ website at www.bos.lacounty.gov.

To address the Board during the live meeting starting at 9:00 a.m. use the information below to connect to the Board meeting:

Registration Instructions

To address the Board, you are encouraged to register by visiting www.publiccomment.lacounty.gov; registration opens at 9:00 a.m. on the day of the meeting:

·	Complete the required fields - be sure to include your phone number if you are participating virtually
·	Choose how you want to provide your comments (In-Person or Virtually)
·	Select the agenda items that you want to comment on and whether you are For, Against, or Neutral on the item
·	Select if you would like to receive text message reminders when your item is up for discussion
·	Click Register
·	Receive Confirmation e-mail

Call-In Instructions

To address the Board virtually during a live meeting, dial the conference line (213) 444-2600 using the telephone number that you provided during registration. Please note that using a different number may delay your access to speak.

·	Press * to access the menu and follow the prompts
o	1 - Listen only
o	3 - Speak on the active item
o	0 - Request to register for multiple items



·	If selected, you will receive a text message reminder when your item is up for discussion on the agenda. 
·	When it is your turn to speak, you will hear a voice announcement and your name

Listen Only

Call (213) 444-2600, press Star (*), after following the prompts, press (1)

Written Testimony

Submit written public comments at: https://publiccomment.bos.lacounty.gov.
